units.dims_m: metres, [w, h, d] in the FRONT image frame: w across, h up, d out of the wall (kit +Z). Wall kits: d = how far the kit stands off the wall face.
units.suggested_sheet_scale: px per metre on the 1920 x 1080 K-sheet (Tools/three_view ladder 2000/1000/500/250; Kit_OutletScrew and Kit_ConduitStrap at 8000 so they read)
units.tris: LOD0 / LOD1 from the P-1 build (outlets_lods); the landing FBX holds LOD0 only until P-1 is approved

images.note: third-angle orthographic at suggested_sheet_scale (1 PNG px = 1 sheet px, place at 100 %), transparent, 16 px clear padding; hero = 1152 x 864, 3/4 from the front-left, 22 degrees down. Kit front = the plate face (no turned kits).

assetsMeta.renderClone: W/proj_outlet_int = main 0a9ee7f + working tree + the outlets fix payload + P-1 LOD kits + the P-4b proposal (RenderSetup patch v2, 2026-10-14 17:4x)
assetsMeta.materials: The materials are the P-4b PROPOSAL (not in main): ThermosetIvory #E6DDC2, NylonIvory #E2D9BF, StainlessBrushed #C7C7C2, Galvanized #B3B5B3. The plate tint is Red's call (VL277): options C #B6AF99 / D #A69F8C. Until P-4b lands the game draws ivory with Prop_PlasticBeige / Prop_PlasticPutty and every metal with Prop_AluminiumAnodised.
dropped: Kit_OutletDuplex20_IG: never referenced by the planner (brown plates and the orange IG device come from the palette); not shipped. Their Blender modules stay in Tools/.
assetsMeta.heights: Mounting heights are not in the kit: the planner places them (centre 0.31/0.41/0.46 m receptacles, 1.07 m off-height, 1.12/1.22 m switches). Wall kits' origin = the wall-face point at the plate centre.
